consensus_items: Extract MAP from unversioned ~/.cursor/ is architecturally justified
DEF-09 dual-read with canonical write is the right migration direction
Non-destructive hooks.json merge + backup is correct default
HMAC marker sealing is correct primitive when secret is stable
--copy as production default; --link for maintainer dev
gitnexus-* and issue-to-pr business code out of scope
